001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.PumpFeaturesV1Response;
007import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.PumpFeaturesV2Response;
008
009import java.math.BigInteger;
010import java.util.Set;
011import java.util.TreeSet;
012
013@HistoryLogProps(
014    opCode = 90,
015    displayName = "New Day",
016    internalName = "LID_NEW_DAY",
017    usedByTidepool = true
018)
019public class NewDayHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
020    
021    private float commandedBasalRate;
022    private long featuresBitmask;
023    private long featureBitmaskIndex;
024
025    public NewDayHistoryLog() {}
026    public NewDayHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, float commandedBasalRate, long featuresBitmask, long featureBitmaskIndex) {
027        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
028        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, commandedBasalRate, featuresBitmask, featureBitmaskIndex);
029        this.commandedBasalRate = commandedBasalRate;
030        this.featuresBitmask = featuresBitmask;
031        this.featureBitmaskIndex = featureBitmaskIndex;
032
033    }
034
035    public NewDayHistoryLog(float commandedBasalRate, long featuresBitmask, long featureBitmaskIndex) {
036        this(0, 0, commandedBasalRate, featuresBitmask, featureBitmaskIndex);
037    }
038
039    public int typeId() {
040        return 90;
041    }
042
043    /**
044     * <table border="1">
045     * <caption>Parsed fields for NewDayHistoryLog:</caption>
046     * <tr><td><code>commandedBasalRate</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
047     * <tr><td><code>featuresBitmask</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
048     * <tr><td><code>featureBitmaskIndex</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
049     * </table>
050     */
051    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
052        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
053        this.cargo = raw;
054        parseBase(raw);
055        this.commandedBasalRate = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 10);
056        this.featuresBitmask = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
057        this.featureBitmaskIndex = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
058
059    }
060
061    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, float commandedBasalRate, long featuresBitmask, long featureBitmaskIndex) {
062        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
063            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(90, 0),
064            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
065            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
066            Bytes.toFloat(commandedBasalRate),
067            Bytes.toUint32(featuresBitmask),
068            Bytes.toUint32(featureBitmaskIndex)));
069    }
070    public float getCommandedBasalRate() {
071        return commandedBasalRate;
072    }
073
074    /**
075     * The pump's main feature bitmask: the {@code pumpFeaturesBitmask} that
076     * {@link PumpFeaturesV2Response} returns for {@link PumpFeaturesV2Response.SupportedFeatureIndex#MAIN_FEATURES}
077     * (index 0), which is also the {@link PumpFeaturesV1Response} bitmask. Decoded by
078     * {@link #getPrimaryFeatures()}. Matched the live response on four of the maintainer's pumps
079     * (t:slim X2 and Mobi).
080     */
081    public long getFeaturesBitmask() {
082        return featuresBitmask;
083    }
084
085    public Set<PumpFeaturesV1Response.PumpFeatureType> getPrimaryFeatures() {
086        return PumpFeaturesV1Response.PumpFeatureType.fromBitmask(BigInteger.valueOf(featuresBitmask));
087    }
088
089    /**
090     * Despite the name, a bitmask of the {@link PumpFeaturesV2Response.SupportedFeatureIndex} values
091     * the pump supports: bit {@code n} is set when {@code PumpFeaturesV2Request} for index {@code n}
092     * gets a status-0 reply. Observed: 21 (indices 0, 2, 4) on older t:slim X2 firmware, 125 (0, 2-6)
093     * on newer X2 firmware, 93 (0, 2, 3, 4, 6) on the Mobi. Decoded by
094     * {@link #getSupportedFeatureIndices()}.
095     */
096    public long getFeatureBitmaskIndex() {
097        return featureBitmaskIndex;
098    }
099
100    public Set<PumpFeaturesV2Response.SupportedFeatureIndex> getSupportedFeatureIndices() {
101        Set<PumpFeaturesV2Response.SupportedFeatureIndex> indices = new TreeSet<>();
102        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
103            if (((featureBitmaskIndex >> i) & 1) == 1) {
104                indices.add(PumpFeaturesV2Response.SupportedFeatureIndex.fromId(i));
105            }
106        }
107        return indices;
108    }
109
110}
